title: Internal Revenue Policy
chunk_text: Internal policy states that revenue may be recognized when invoice is issued. This policy may be outdated if external standards require performance obligation analysis.

title: External Revenue Recognition Guidance
chunk_text: Revenue recognition should be based on the transfer of goods or services and satisfaction of performance obligations, not merely invoice issuance.

title: Audit Evidence Guidance
chunk_text: Audit conclusions should be supported by sufficient and appropriate evidence. Unsupported conclusions require manual review.
